card.name: Start of intra- and urinary words
card.fires_on: The first pieces of split medical words like intra-detrusor, intra-cavernosally, intra-vascular and urinary, where the rest of the word is still to come. Also fires on 'of' in 'return of blood'.

modes.label: Intra- route words
modes.description: The opening or middle piece of 'intra...' injection-route words such as intradetrusor or intracavernosally.

modes.label: Urinary start
modes.description: The 'Ur' piece starting the word urinary in warnings and adverse effect lists.

modes.label: Return of blood
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'return' in aspiration instructions for local anesthetic injection.
modes.example: until no return<< of>> blood can be elicited by aspiration.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; it favors some Chinese word pieces and suppresses 'compression' words.
card.plain: It lights up partway into long words about injection routes or the urinary tract, before the word is finished.
